ideas.title: Minnesota Human Services Fraud: A 50-Year History
ideas.description: Investigate the history of fraud in Minnesota's human services department and the effectiveness of current oversight and accountability measures.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the role of the new commissioner in addressing the issue
questions: What are the root causes of the fraud?
How effective are current oversight measures?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal systemic issues in Minnesota's human services department and the challenges of addressing long-standing problems.

ideas.title: Fresno Arts Council Embezzlement: Who's Behind the $1.5M Theft?
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged embezzlement from the Fresno Arts Council and the suspect's background.
ideas.angle: Examine the investigation and the impact on the community
questions: What are the implications for the Fresno Arts Council?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal details about the embezzlement and the suspect's motives.
